Couldn’t eat it
Apr 2025 • Couples
We ordered 3 dishes: veg spring rolls (tasted not fresh), chicken rice (ok), beef salad (inedible).
We were served chewy white meat in the beef salad, no red meat, so we asked if it was pork. They assured us it was beef, but it tasted nothing like beef. Dish was inedible so we asked them to remove it from the bill. They refused saying we had ordered it. We did, but couldn’t eat it.
Recommend you give this one a miss.

Do not go here.
Aug 2023 • Family
Worst restaurant visited in two weeks in Vietnam.

During our lengthy wait to order, four servers at once delivered drinks to a table of two.

Then, our waiter said they were out of pho (around 8:00 pm.) Then, he said they were out of fish noodles. What was finally available was bland fried rice.

A child in our party wanted ice cream, but the waiter failed to place order. Upon inquiry from a native Vietnamese speaker, he responded, "What is ice cream? (Kem.)" We ended up walking down the street to a nice ice cream parlor.

Overall, the vibe was that it was a place for posers. The food and service was terrible. There are much better options from street vendors.

Worst meal in Vietnam till date - only saving grace was that we weren’t charged for 2 dishes
Jan 2018 • Couples
Had the worse meal so far of the trip on the last night of our trip. 
Out of the 6 dishes we ordered 3 were not available, 2 were not edible and 1 was mediocre at best. 
We reached quite late to the restaurant hence it was understandable that some dishes weren’t available however out of the 3 dishes served - 1. Vietnamese pancake 2. Korean octopus spicy curry and 3. the pork chop with broken rice, only the pork chop was edible. The pancake was dripping with oil and left grease all over the plate and our mouth. The Korean octopus was unchewable. 
After a bunch of arguments with the staff, one waiter actually picked up a knife and fork and attempted slicing a piece of octopus on our table itself - which he was unable to do. 
Thankfully, we weren’t charged for both these dishes as the staff understood the terrible quality of the meal despite the language barrier.

Nice ambience
Nov 2016
One step into this Ngon sia House, and one thing will hit you : the ambience. 

It is comfy (relatively) and vibce is trendy. It is supposedly a place where many of Saigon;s famous and well know stalls are housed under one roof - something like a chinese coffeeshop in Malaysia, only thing is that it has a ncer decor. 

Food is not too bad. But it isnt brilliant either. However, much like its other cousin on Pasteur street, it is convenient. It has basically a host of dishes to choose from the various vendors of their "stalls'. If you are a tourist in Saigon for a few days, this would be one of the places where you can try "the local" dishes .

Price-wise, it's a little bit higher than what you would pay eating at the stalls

Nice wood structure restaurant in city center. Variety of asian food, Vietnamese, Thai, Chinese, Japanese. We did ordered many Vietnamese dishes, all grease and tasteless. Normally Pho must served with sauce and fresh vegetable for each set. I have got only noodle, but don't get sauce and vegetable while my friend got. Then we requested many times, finally won't get it.

Poor Service, Better Food
Nov 2016 • Couples
There is a great selection of food to eat and having the pictures of the food on the menu certainly helps. 

Between the two of us we ordered a selection of dishes from the five ethnicities available. Unfortunately our waitress that we had wrote down the wrong number and gave us a wrong meal but refused to exchange our meal or provide us with the meal we requested. 

Upon paying for our meal the same waitress questioned why we were unwilling to pay for the meal we did not request.

There seemed to be a lot of people on group tours enjoying their meals in this restaurant, it also doesn't matter where you sit as they'll bring your meal to you s there is 3 floors restaurants. 

Despite our altercation with the restaurant staff member we would go back there again, just not in a hurry!
